usedFor: Pitchit holds pitches and lead insights, and HubSpot records the lead through “Create Contact” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's insights are updated” in Pitchit, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: New insight changes how promising a deal looks, so the deal's properties can be kept current.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs a deal ID, so the trigger must carry one or the update has nothing to target.
